tasks.subject: Task 1: Swift package skeleton with a Core target
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A buildable two-target SwiftPM package pinned to Foundry-Swift-Binary 0.1.0-alpha.2, with FoundryKitCore as a shared dynamic product and FoundryKitAuth depending on it.

**Files:**
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Package.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitCore/CorrelatedSignal.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/Placeholder.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Tests/FoundryKitCoreTests/CorrelatedSignalTests.swift
- Modify: .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- swift build succeeds against Foundry-Swift-Binary 0.1.0-alpha.2
- swift test runs and passes
- FoundryKitCore is .dynamic; FoundryKitAuth depends on it
- FoundryKitCore holds no shared mutable static state
- .build/ and *.xcodeproj are gitignored
- The alpha.1 to alpha.2 bump is confirmed working, or the failure is reported rather than worked around

**Verify:** cd native/apple/FoundryKitNative && swift test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Package.swift", "native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitCore/CorrelatedSignal.swift", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "cd native/apple/FoundryKitNative && swift test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["swift build succeeds on alpha.2", "swift test passes", "FoundryKitCore is dynamic and holds no static mutable state", "build output is gitignored"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Correlation-token filtering in NativeRequest
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Teach core/NativeRequest to ignore emissions that do not answer the request it is awaiting, without changing behaviour for any existing caller.

**Files:**
- Modify: addons/FoundryKit/core/NativeRequest.fs
- Modify: test_project/tests/support/fake_native.notest.fs
- Modify: test_project/tests/native-request.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- await_outcome accepts correlation_token: String defaulting to ""
- With a non-empty token, a mismatched emission is ignored without settling
- A matching emission settles and the token is not in the payload
- With an empty token, behaviour is exactly today's
- The failure signal is filtered by the same rule
- Every pre-existing NativeRequestTests case still passes unchanged
- The class doc comment no longer disclaims correlation

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/core/NativeRequest.fs", "test_project/tests/support/fake_native.notest.fs", "test_project/tests/native-request.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["mismatched emissions are ignored without settling", "empty token preserves existing behaviour", "all pre-existing NativeRequestTests pass unchanged"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: The Google Sign-In native class
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Swift class that drives GoogleSignIn and emits correlated results.

**Files:**
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/SignInOutcome.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/GoogleSignIn.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/FoundryKitAuthEntry.swift
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Tests/FoundryKitAuthTests/SignInOutcomeTests.swift
- Delete: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/Placeholder.swift
- Modify: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Package.swift

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- signIn(nonce:requestToken:) and signInSilent(requestToken:) take a correlation token
- signInSuccess emits (request_token, id_token, email, display_name, authorization_code)
- signInFailed emits (request_token, code, message)
- Pure mapping functions are unit-tested without a host bundle
- #initFoundryExtension uses cdecl foundry_kit_auth_entry_point
- No provider diagnostic detail reaches the emitted message

**Verify:** cd native/apple/FoundryKitNative && swift test

```json:metadata
{"files": ["native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/GoogleSignIn.swift", "native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/SignInOutcome.swift", "native/apple/FoundryKitNative/Sources/FoundryKitAuth/FoundryKitAuthEntry.swift"], "verifyCommand": "cd native/apple/FoundryKitNative && swift test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["token is the first argument of both signals", "pure mapping functions are tested without a host bundle", "no provider diagnostics reach the emitted message"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: xcframework build
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A reproducible build producing FoundryKitAuth.xcframework and FoundryKitCore.framework, driven by a task target.

**Files:**
- Create: native/apple/FoundryKitNative/project.yml
- Create: scripts/build-apple-auth
- Modify: Taskfile.yml
- Modify: .gitignore

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- task apple:auth produces addons/FoundryKit/bin/auth/FoundryKitAuth.xcframework with device and simulator slices, plus bin/core/FoundryKitCore.framework
- Binary outputs are gitignored
- The script fails loudly with a named missing tool
- BUILD_LIBRARY_FOR_DISTRIBUTION is set
- LD_RUNPATH_SEARCH_PATHS resolves FoundrySwift and FoundryKitCore at load time
- The script is idempotent

**Verify:** task apple:auth

```json:metadata
{"files": ["native/apple/FoundryKitNative/project.yml", "scripts/build-apple-auth", "Taskfile.yml", ".gitignore"], "verifyCommand": "task apple:auth", "acceptanceCriteria": ["xcframework has device and simulator slices", "binaries are gitignored", "running twice leaves the same tree"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 5: Extension registration
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Register the auth binary with the engine so iOSGoogleSignIn appears in ClassDB.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/FoundryKitAuth.foundryextension
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/bin/auth/.gitkeep, addons/FoundryKit/bin/core/.gitkeep

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- entry_symbol is foundry_kit_auth_entry_point, matching the cdecl exactly
- [libraries] covers iOS device, iOS simulator and macOS arm64
- [dependencies] lists FoundryKitCore.framework for every slice
- .gitkeep files keep the bin directories present despite the gitignore
- With binaries absent, task test:foundrylib still passes

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/FoundryKitAuth.foundryextension"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["entry_symbol matches the cdecl", "core framework is listed as a dependency for every slice", "absent binaries degrade rather than break"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: AppleAuthBackend
tasks.description:
**Goal:** The Foundry Script backend that drives the native class through NativeRequest and returns a Credential.

**Files:**
- Create: addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/AppleAuthBackend.fs
- Create: test_project/tests/auth-apple-backend.test.fs
- Create: test_project/tests/support/fake_google_native.notest.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Satisfies AuthBackend via uses
- sign_in(Provider.GOOGLE) generates a fresh correlation token per call
- Success maps to CredentialResult.Success(Credential.Google(...))
- Failure maps through AuthError.from_native
- Provider.APPLE and Provider.EMAIL_PASSWORD return Unavailable
- With the native absent, is_available is false and sign_in returns Unavailable without hanging
- Session storage returns Storage; Keychain is epic E
- backend_name() returns "apple"

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/AppleAuthBackend.fs", "test_project/tests/auth-apple-backend.test.fs", "test_project/tests/support/fake_google_native.notest.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["fresh correlation token per sign_in call", "non-Google providers return Unavailable", "absent native does not hang"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 7: Wire the factory
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Route iOS and macOS to the Apple backend.

**Files:**
- Modify: addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/AuthBackendFactory.fs
- Modify: test_project/tests/auth-backend-factory.test.fs

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- PlatformKind.IOS and PlatformKind.MACOS resolve to AppleAuthBackend
- ANDROID, DESKTOP and UNKNOWN still resolve to NullAuthBackend
- The epic-ownership comment is updated, not deleted
- The Apple backend constructs and reports unavailable without the binary
- test_resolve_current_returns_a_backend no longer asserts "null" — it would pass in Linux CI and fail on every developer's Mac

**Verify:** task test:foundrylib

```json:metadata
{"files": ["addons/FoundryKit/auth/internal/AuthBackendFactory.fs", "test_project/tests/auth-backend-factory.test.fs"], "verifyCommand": "task test:foundrylib", "acceptanceCriteria": ["Apple platforms resolve to the Apple backend", "other platforms still resolve to null", "resolve_current assertion is platform-independent"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 8: macOS CI
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Build the Swift package and run its tests on every PR.

**Files:**
- Modify: .github/workflows/pr-check.yml

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- A new apple job runs on macos-26
- It runs swift test and task apple:auth
- Derived data is cached, keyed on Package.resolved and project.yml
- No App token step — both dependencies are public
- The three existing jobs are untouched and keep their exact names
- The new job is not added to branch protection in this task
- Its wall-clock duration is recorded in the PR body

**Verify:** gh pr checks <PR>

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/pr-check.yml"], "verifyCommand": "gh pr checks <PR> --repo cafecito-games/FoundryKit", "acceptanceCriteria": ["apple job green on macos-26", "existing three job names unchanged", "duration recorded in the PR body"]}
```
